# #5188: Patch: card sound hooks for triggered effects (turn, Whenever, Activate, hurt, hit), line pools, effect sequences and a 32 MiB voice budget
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Part 1 of #5187. Its Today and space-rules sections hold the measurements this part relies on. Nothing blocks it; part 3 can build beside it.

## What it does

Adds to `apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5` the hooks and shapes the card parts will fill, the rules for when those hooks play, and room on disk for their lines. **It writes no new voice line**, so it needs no render.

## The new hooks (client only: R655, R203; CLAUDE.md rule 7)

| Hook | Plays when | From the event stream |
|---|---|---|
| `startOfTurn` | a start-of-turn hook of the card begins to resolve, on either player's turn | `hookResolving` with `hook: "startOfTurn"` and the card as `sourceId` (R2783000) |
| `endOfTurn` | an end-of-turn hook of it begins to resolve | `hookResolving`, `"endOfTurn"` |
| `whenever` | one of its Whenever triggers runs, its condition held | `hookResolving`, `"whenever"` |
| `activate` | one of its Activate abilities runs | `hookResolving`, `"activate"` |
| `hurt` | a Unit takes damage and is still on the field when that action ends | `damage` on it, amount above 0, with no `destroyed` of it in that action |
| `hit` | damage the card is the source of lands: its Spell's, its effect's or its attack's | `damage` with the card as `sourceId` |

Each takes what today's hooks take: `{ voice }`, `{ effect }`, or both, with the effect first. A line's words go in the card's `voice` in `crates/cards/card-text.yaml`, under the hook's name. `hookResolving`'s `cry` and `death` add no hook, because `play`, `cast` and `death` already sound at R204's moments. Part 2 adds the hooks R2783000 leaves unmarked.

## Two new shapes

- **Line pools.** Any voiced hook may give a list of lines, as `trigger` does (R1088). That includes today's `play`, `attack`, `death` and `cast`. One line is picked by the client's cosmetic rng, never the match's. The first line keeps today's key and file (`<id>-play`), and the others are `<id>-play2`, `<id>-play3`, and so on. A new hook's keys are `<id>-startOfTurn`, `<id>-startOfTurn2`, and so on. `apps/web/scripts/gen-voice.mjs` renders and checks them, and no shipped file's key changes.
- **Effect sequences.** `effect` may be a list of bank effects, played in order with a named gap between them: a wind-up, the release, a tail. The card parts build Spell sounds from these.

## When a recurring hook speaks

`startOfTurn`, `endOfTurn`, `whenever`, `activate`, `hurt` and `hit` can fire every turn, or many times in one action, so:

- its effect plays each time, once per entry, and a condensed burst keeps one, as R655 has it;
- its line speaks the first time the hook fires in a game. After that it speaks at most once per turn per card, with a chance (`TRIGGER_LINE_CHANCE`, about 1 in 3) drawn from the cosmetic rng;
- the line has R204's lowest priority: it never cuts in on another line, waits briefly, and is dropped if it waits too long.

The constants go in `apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts` (CLAUDE.md rule 9). Both seats hear the hook of a card the viewer can read; `attack` is different, since only the viewer's own pick-up plays it. A card behind the sentinel plays nothing (R203), and `hookResolving` never reaches a seat that could not read the card (R2783000).

## Space (#5187, the space rules)

- `VOICE_BUDGET_BYTES` (`apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts`) and `BUDGET_BYTES` (`gen-voice.mjs`) go from 24 to **32 MiB**, still counted in 4 KiB blocks. The change comes under a ruling from this issue's block that states the arithmetic (#5187, space rule 4), as R1884000 and R3596000 did.
- New lines are four words at most, checked where the attack lines are checked (`voice-lines.test.ts`).
- **A gzip cap on the sound tables** (`card-audio.json5`, `voice-text.json`, `voice-manifest.json`), as a named constant. Set it from today's 89 KB plus the card parts' growth (about 3,000 hook entries and at most 1,331 lines), with room for that and no more. Test it the way `apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts` tests the first load (#3499).
- **The census.** A test that counts, for every card in the ranges it lists, the sounds added since this part. The lines and effects on `main` before this part are its baseline, and the test may snapshot them. It fails on any card below its rarity's floor or above its voice ceiling (#5187's table, as named constants). It lists no range yet: each card part adds its own, a range of catalog ids per line.

## Also

- **Spec:** §10.11's Card hooks and Voice lines paragraphs, and a ruling note from this issue's block with its proving tests. The ruling amends R655 (the hooks), R1088 (pools on every hook) and R204 (the new lines' priority). Its §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/<N>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- **Docs:** the headers of `card-audio.json5` and `card-text.yaml`, and rows 6 and 7 of `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, say what a card may now carry.
- **Proof:** test fixtures, plus effect-only hooks (which render nothing) on at most four real cards, one per `hookResolving` kind.

## Acceptance

- [ ] each of the six hooks plays its card's effect and line at its moment, and nothing for a card behind the sentinel (`director.test.ts`, `cues.test.ts`)
- [ ] pools work on every voiced hook, keyed as above; `gen-voice.mjs --check` and `gen-voice.test.ts` know them, and no shipped key changes (`--check` on `main`'s files still passes)
- [ ] effect sequences play in order, their gap a named constant
- [ ] the recurring-hook rule holds, with its constants
- [ ] the budget is 32 MiB in both places, under its ruling
- [ ] the four-word cap, the tables' gzip cap and the census (with no ranges yet) are in place
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` are green

- **Space.** The voice budget becomes 32 MiB in both places. New lines are four words at most. The sound tables get a gzip cap. A census lands with no ranges yet.

## Steps

1. **Before any edit**, from `apps/web`, write the baseline:
   ```sh
   node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),J=require("json5");const a=J.parse(fs.readFileSync("src/audio/card-audio.json5","utf8")).cards,t=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("src/audio/voice-text.json","utf8")).cards,o={};for(const[id,e]of Object.entries(a)){const w=t[id]??{},u=[];for(const[h,x]of Object.entries(e)){if(x.voice!==undefined){const l=w[h];if(h==="trigger")l.forEach((_,i)=>u.push(`trigger${i+1}`));else if(Array.isArray(l))l.forEach((_,i)=>u.push(i?`${h}${i+1}`:h));else u.push(h)}if(x.effect!==undefined)u.push(`fx:${h}`)}o[id]=u.sort()}fs.writeFileSync("src/audio/census-baseline.json",JSON.stringify(o,null,1)+"\n")'
   ```
2. **constants.ts**

     - `startOfTurn`, `endOfTurn`, `whenever`, `activate` and `hit`: `{ kinds: ["unit", "spell", "trap"] }`.
     - `hurt`: `{ kinds: ["unit"] }`.

     Add `RECURRING_HOOKS: ReadonlySet<CardHook>` holding those six.
   - **Priority.** `VOICE_PRIORITY = { recurring: 0, summon: 0, play: 1, react: 2, pickup: 3 }`. Comment `recurring` as "R5188000: R204's lowest".

   - **Rule and gap.** `TRIGGER_LINE_CHANCE = 1 / 3`. `EFFECT_SEQUENCE_GAP_MS = 60`: the next effect starts this long after the previous one ends.
   - **Gzip cap.** `SOUND_TABLES_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES = 18 * 8192`. Its doc records:

     - `CENSUS_SOUND_FLOOR: Readonly<Record<Rarity, number>> = { Token: 1, Common: 2, Rare: 3, Epic: 4, Legendary: 5, Mythic: 6 }`.
     - `CENSUS_VOICE_CEILING = { Token: 0, Common: 1, Rare: 1, Epic: 2, Legendary: 3, Mythic: 4 }`.

   - **Budget.** `VOICE_BUDGET_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024`, citing R5188001.

   - Add `export type HookEffect = string | string[]` and use it for `effect` in every `HookAssignment` variant.

   - A bad shape fails at `${path}.effect` with "must be an effect or a non-empty list of effects".
   - An unknown name fails at `${path}.effect[i]` with `unknown effect "<name>"`.
   - Return the effect as written. Change the comment to say any hook may list lines (R5188000).
5. **soundTables.ts `withVoiceText`**: the key becomes `[hook === "trigger" || Array.isArray(own[hook]) ? "lines" : "text"]`.
6. **voiceData.ts**
   - **`hookLines(table, defId, hook): PlayableLineKind[]`**:
     - no voice: `[]`;
     - a trigger: `trigger1…n`;
     - a pool: `hook`, `hook2`, and so on;
     - a text: `[hook]`.
   - **`pickLine(table, defId, hook, random)`**:
     - no lines: null;
     - one line: that line, without drawing from the rng;
     - otherwise `lines[min(n-1, floor(random()*n))]`.
   - **`lineFor`** matches `/^([A-Za-z]+?)(\d+)$/`:
     - `trigger<n>` resolves as today;
     - any other `CARD_HOOK_NAMES` hook with n ≥ 2 gives pool line n-1;
     - a bare hook gives its text, or `lines[0]` for a pool;
     - a bare `trigger` gives null;
     - any other name goes to `emoteLineFor`.
   - **`effectsFor(table, defId, hook)`** returns `{ name, effect }[]`. `effectFor` becomes `effectsFor(...)[0] ?? null`.
7. **engine.ts `startEffect`**: return `GainNode[] | null | false`, looping over `effectsFor`.
   - Run the retrigger guard and the `SFX_MAX_VOICES` check once, on the first name.
   - Each element keeps today's work: its own cue node into `buses.sfx`, jitter, `lastEffectAt`, `sfxEnds`, duck, disconnect, and a log entry with `delayMs: at`.
   - After each element, `at += Math.round(lengthMs) + EFFECT_SEQUENCE_GAP_MS`.
   - On a suspended context, log every element as suspended at `delay`.
   - `pickupEffect` becomes `GainNode[] | null`, and every node in it fades.
8. **engine.ts `playPickup`**
   - `line = pickLine(loadedLines, defId, "attack", random)`.
   - `hasLine` needs `line !== null` plus either the line's manifest key or a `lineFor` result.
   - Call `playVoice(defId, line, …)`.
   - `hasEffect = effectsFor(...).length > 0`.

   - `lineGate?: (card: string, hook: CardHook) => boolean`
   - `survives?: (event: GameEvent) => boolean`
   - `named?: (instanceId: string) => string | undefined`
10. **cues.ts `hookCues`**: add a 6th parameter, `card?: string`.
    - Push the effect cue as today.
    - If the hook has a voice, stop when `RECURRING_HOOKS.has(hook) && ctx.lineGate?.(card ?? defId, hook) === false`.
    - Otherwise push `voice(defId, pickLine(ctx.lines, defId, hook, ctx.random ?? Math.random), …)` with today's delays.
11. **cues.ts**
    - **`HookKind`**: copy the type from `fx/hooks.test.ts:19`, `type HookKind = Extract<GameEvent, { type: "hookResolving" }>["hook"]`.
    - **`MARKED_HOOKS: Readonly<Record<HookKind, CardHook | null>>`**: `cry` and `death` map to null; every other kind maps to its own name.
    - **The `hookResolving` row**:
      - `sfx: null`.
      - `silentBecause`: "a marker with no sound of its own: its card's turn, Whenever or Activate hook sounds (R5188000); a Cry and a Death at R204's moments".

    - **`readableDefOf(ctx, id)`**: try `defIdOfInstance(ctx.view, id)`, then the newest view, then `ctx.named?.(id)`.
    - **`damageCues`**: if the amount is above 0, after today's cues:
      - add `hurt` for `ctx.unitNow?.(targetId)?.defId ?? defIdOfInstance(ctx.view, targetId)`, card `targetId`, unless `ctx.survives?.(event) === false`;
      - add `hit` for `readableDefOf(ctx, sourceId)`, card `sourceId`, when `sourceId` isn't null and resolves;
      - both at delay 0 and `VOICE_PRIORITY.recurring`.
12. **director.ts**
    - **State.**
      - `heardHooks = new Set<string>()` holds `card|hook`. It is never cleared: there is one director per board, so it survives a hand-over.
      - `spokeThisTurn = new Set<string>()` and `named = new Map<string, string>()` are both cleared on `turnStarted` in `follow`.
    - **`lineGate`**:
      - a new `card|hook` joins both sets and returns true;
      - a card already in `spokeThisTurn` returns false;
      - otherwise it returns `rng() < TRIGGER_LINE_CHANCE`, and on true adds the card to `spokeThisTurn`.
    - **`named`**: in `resolve`, after `cuesFor`:
      - `cardPlayed`, `summoned` and `trapFired` set `named` by instanceId;
      - `hookResolving` sets it by sourceId;
      - an event whose defId is `HIDDEN_DEF_ID` deletes that entry instead.
    - **`leftField = new WeakSet<GameEvent>()`**: in `onView`'s batch, add each `damage` with an amount above 0 where `findUnit(view, targetId) === null`.

15. **card-audio.json5**
    - **Header**: document the six hooks; pools (a list of words, keyed `<id>-<hook>`, `<id>-<hook>2`, and so on); effect lists, played in order; and the recurring rule.

      - `"core-033"`: `activate: { effect: "dataBlips" }`
16. **Labels**

17. **test/census.ts** (pure functions, no `fs`)

      - `<id>: <n> sounds added, below the <rarity> floor of <f>`
      - `<id>: <n> lines added, above the <rarity> ceiling of <c>`

      A unit counts as added when the baseline doesn't have it. Lines are the units without the `fx:` prefix.
